description: Pinterest API enables programmatic creation and management of pins, boards, ad campaigns, product catalogs, and analytics.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow for public apps, with access tokens used as bearer tokens in request headers.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free developer account on the Pinterest Developer Portal and create apps self-serve at no cost.
api_notes: Covers pins, boards, board sections, ad campaigns, ad groups, ads, targeting options, conversion tracking, analytics, and shopping catalogs.
mcp_notes: The developer site mentions 'Pinterest MCP is on the way' under upcoming features, but no official production MCP server is published yet.
rationale: Pinterest provides a fully documented REST API v5 and free self-serve developer accounts with standard OAuth2 authentication.

evidence.note: Details OAuth 2.0 authentication flows and access tokens.
Explains how to set up a developer account and register applications.
Outlines Pinterest REST API v5 scope covering pins, boards, ads, and analytics.
Notes that Pinterest MCP is on the way.

open_questions: Exact release timeline for the official Pinterest Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
